name: QiYi Thunderclap V3 M 3x3
description: The Thunderclap V3 M is the latest release in the Thunderclap series by QiYi MoFangGe. This budget friendly magnetic 3x3 speed cube features a host of new upgrades including all primary plastic internals, a capped design to avoid seams, an updated anti-pop mechanism, tracks on the pieces to reduce friction, and slots to assure correct magnet positioning. This puzzle has a classic QiYi feel for a great price!
